questions.question: “记住我”的具体时长和安全级别要求是什么？
questions.why: 这直接决定技术方案是简单延长Session还是引入Refresh Token体系，以及是否需要配合设备指纹或二次验证，影响开发工作量和安全合规性。

questions.question: 如果用户在其他设备登录或修改密码，“记住我”的状态是否需要自动失效？
questions.why: 这关系到账号安全兜底策略。若不联动失效，演示或实际使用中可能出现账号被盗用风险；若需联动，则后端需增加Token黑名单或版本校验逻辑。
options: 需要立即失效所有记住我状态

暂不考虑，优先保证演示功能可用

db60993f04241ef4e4947db0a2ad206056ace874.title: Bookkeeping Calculator MVP
db60993f04241ef4e4947db0a2ad206056ace874.understanding: Develop a user-friendly calculator application tailored for everyday bookkeeping that offers improved UX over standard phone calculators, with a functional prototype deliverable by end of this week.

subtasks.title: Define Core Bookkeeping Features
subtasks.detail: Identify specific bookkeeping workflows (e.g., running totals, tax calculation, category tagging) that distinguish this from a standard calculator to scope the MVP.

subtasks.title: Design Enhanced UX/UI
subtasks.detail: Create wireframes focusing on 'nicer' aesthetics and usability improvements like larger tap targets, history visibility, or dark mode.

subtasks.title: Implement Calculation Logic
subtasks.detail: Build the core arithmetic engine with support for bookkeeping-specific functions and persistent memory/tape functionality.

subtasks.title: Develop Frontend Prototype
subtasks.detail: Code the interactive UI based on designs, ensuring responsive layout and smooth interactions for the weekly demo.

subtasks.title: User Testing & Refinement
subtasks.detail: Conduct quick usability testing with the requester to validate the 'nicer than phone' requirement before the Friday deadline.

known: Deadline for initial visibility is this week (approx. 2026-10-30)
Must be superior in UX/utility to default phone calculator
Primary use case is everyday bookkeeping

questions.question: What specific bookkeeping pain points does your current phone calculator fail to address?
questions.why: 'Nicer' is subjective; without knowing if you need running totals, tax buttons, or export features, we risk building a pretty but useless tool.

questions.question: What platform should this prototype target for this week's demo?
questions.why: Building native iOS/Android takes longer than a PWA/web app; platform choice dictates whether we can realistically ship a polished version in 6 days.

questions.question: Does 'see something this week' mean a clickable design prototype or a fully functional coded app?
questions.why: A high-fidelity design prototype is guaranteed in 6 days; a functional bug-free app with custom logic carries significant schedule risk.
options: Hybrid (core feature working + design for rest)
